messages:
laura (partnerships): Heads up  NebulaWorks sent over the co-marketing assets for the Cloud Marketplace tile, solution brief, and a draft customer case (SolaceBank). Can we do a quick asset QA and rights check? Files: NW-Redwood-MktAssets.zip, NW_Redwood_SolBrief_v2.pdf, SolaceBank_case_v0.9.docx

chris (design): pulling them down now. First glance: logo folder has only PNGs and a low-res SVG export. Need original vector (AI/EPS/SVG) and a reverse white version that actually has alpha channel. Marketplace expects 1:1 square thumbnail and 16:9 banner variants.

dani (marketing): We'll need a neutral marketplace blurb (120 chars) + 25-30 word summary for metadata, and a 1-line partner credit for the solution brief. Also check their brand line about "managed GPUs"  avoid any claims about uptime/SLA in the blurb.

rachel (legal): Do not publish partner logos until we have the signed co-marketing/logo use form. Also request their proof of trademark registration for our records. For the SolaceBank case: confirm customer permission for industry/regulatory callouts (they mention "PCI-compliant" in draft).

tom (solutions): Note on the technical callouts: they placed our "Private (VPC)" capability in the brief but the architecture diagram shows a hosted flow. We'll need to correct the diagram or reword the text so it doesn't imply hosted data transfer. Also watch for screenshots  ensure no account IDs or tokens.

chris (design): Specific asks I'll include in the assets email:
- original vectors: nebula_logo.ai, nebula_logo.eps, nebula_logo.svg
- PNG @1x, @2x for light/dark
- white-reverse with alpha (PNG/SVG)
- full brand pdf: NW_brand_guidelines.pdf (spacing, safe area, color palette)
- color hex values + gradient stops (their gradient reads #0847D9 -> #6BE1FF in PSD but the PDF lists #0846D8 -> #6AE2FE)
- accessibility alt text for logos (short description)

laura (partnerships): Good. Dani please propose two blurb options that are neutral.

dani (marketing): Options:
A) "Redwood Inference and NebulaWorks deliver private, high-throughput LLM inference on dedicated GPU infrastructure."
B) "Deploy low-latency LLM inference via Redwood Inference on NebulaWorksdedicated infrastructure."
Which reads less like a claim? I think A is more descriptive, B implies a deployment action.

rachel (legal): A is fine but add partner attribution language: "NebulaWorks is a registered trademark of NebulaWorks, Inc." Also ask them to sign the co-marketing agreement and the logo license.

tom (solutions): On the case: SolaceBank references latency numbers (p50/p95). Are those customer-approved? If not, redact or use ranges. Also replace internal IP addresses in diagrams with placeholders.

assets-bot: Reminder: partnership-assets-deadline scheduled for 36 hours from now.

chris (design): Minor nit: their horizontal lockup file has 10px too much top padding per their brand guide (makes the baseline appear off when centered). Ask them to supply both the "baseline" aligned and centered versions.

dani (marketing): 30-word metadata draft: "Redwood Inference and NebulaWorks provide a co-managed inference solution offering low-latency private deployment options and optimized GPU throughput for regulated enterprise workloads." Thoughts?

rachel (legal): Recommend changing "co-managed" to "integrated" to avoid implying operational responsibilities. Also confirm SolaceBank quote signoff and no PHI/PCI-sensitive screenshots.

laura (partnerships): Action items: 1) Chris send asset request (vectors, reverse versions, color proof, alt text). 2) Dani finalize blurb choosing A with legal's attribution tweak. 3) Rachel request signed logo license + TM proof + customer quote permissions. 4) Tom verify diagrams and redact any IDs. I'll reach out to NebulaWorks rep and cc legal.

chris (design): I'll paste an asset request template in #templates and include required marketplace image sizes: 1200x1200 (square), 1600x900 (banner), 300x300 (small). Also ask for layered source files for the architecture diagram (PSD/SVG).

dani (marketing): Final blurb draft for signoff: "Redwood Inference and NebulaWorks provide private, high-throughput LLM inference on dedicated GPU infrastructure. NebulaWorks is a registered trademark of NebulaWorks, Inc."

rachel (legal): OK, send that with a copy of the co-marketing agreement. Please flag any claims about compliance/PCI and get explicit permission from SolaceBank.

laura (partnerships): If NebulaWorks gets us the signed forms and corrected assets by EOD tomorrow we should make the next marketplace batch. I'll follow up after their reply. :rocket:
